messages:
Priya Nair: Quick heads-up — flight delayed due to de-icing. ETA to home ~23:50 PST, customs/security might add 30–60m. I’m rostered primary for 00:00–08:00 PST tonight; I won’t make the 00:00 handoff. Can someone pick up primary for at least 00:00–04:00? If possible split shift is fine. Sorry for the late ping.

Jordan Lee: I can cover 00:00–02:00 PST but I have a standing oncall meeting 02:00–03:30 I can't move. If someone can take 02:00–08:00 that’d work. I have pager access and keys.

Sam Ortiz: I can take 02:00–08:00 PST. Confirming I have access to the infra keys and can run DB failover steps (haven't done full failover in prod in a few months but have practiced on staging). Will need a quick handoff checklist from Priya for anything warm in cache.

Kai Wong: I can be secondary for the whole window (00:00–08:00). Note: there’s scheduled infra maintenance at 03:30–03:45 PST (network switch validation) — should be low-risk but expect noisy alerts from infra monitoring. I'll keep phone on.

Priya Nair: Amazing, thank you all. Plan then: Jordan primary 00:00–02:00, Sam primary 02:00–08:00, Kai secondary 00:00–08:00. I’ll update PD and calendar now. Handoff notes (quick):
- Current active incidents: none. Last sev (P2) resolved earlier today, ticket #INC-4821.
- Known flaky: embedder pool 3 has slower cold-starts; avoid rolling model there unless you want to chase perf alerts.
- DB read-replicas healthy; primary failover runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/db-failover 
- Critical runbooks: /runbooks/oncall-primary, /runbooks/kv-cache-restart

Priya Nair: Handoff checklist (copy/paste):
```
- Confirm pager access (PD) and email oncall@redwood.com
- Verify tokens: service-token-prod expiry > 7d (cli: /scripts/check-token.sh)
- Snapshot recent logs: sudo /opt/logs/collect last 1h > /tmp/handoff-logs.tgz
- Post short note to #eng-oncall when taking over
```

Jordan Lee: Pager check done, I get alerts. Ran token check: tokens OK. I’ll post to PD that I’m primary at 23:58 PST. Quick question — who has the service account for remote model reload? Is it the platform-sa or redwood-deploy?

Priya Nair: platform-sa holds reload rights. I’ll DM creds scope to Sam and Kai now.

incident-bot: Reminder: Scheduled maintenance: network-switch-validation @ 2026-03-14 03:30 PST — expected duration 15m. No customer impact expected.

Sam Ortiz: Got creds. I’ll run through a dry run of model reload on staging at 01:30 PST to refresh muscle memory. If anything looks off during 03:30 maintenance we’ll coordinate in this thread.

Marta Reyes: Thanks team — I’ve updated the rotation calendar and the PagerDuty rotation as requested: Jordan primary 00:00–02:00, Sam primary 02:00–08:00, Kai secondary 00:00–08:00. Priya, please mark OOO on calendar so the roster shows correctly. Also: please add a one-line note in /runbooks/oncall-primary under "midnight handoffs" describing the embedder pool 3 flakiness.

Priya Nair: Done — calendar updated, PD patched, and I added the embedder note. Leaving a quick sticky for the handoff:
- Jordan: focus first 20m on traffic baselines (console -> /metrics/token_rate, /metrics/latency)
- Sam: at 02:00 run a canary prompt through the hosted API and check for 99th pct latency regressions before accepting full primary.

Jordan Lee: Will do. Quick sanity test (manual PD test, not actual prod incident):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://pager.test/simulate" -d '{"target":"eng-oncall","reason":"handshake test","actor":"Jordan"}'
```

incident-bot: Test alert delivered to eng-oncall. Acknowledged by Jordan Lee. :white_check_mark:

Kai Wong: All clear on my side — logs access and runbook links verified. I'll watch for noisy alerts around 03:30 and mute infra false-positives if they spike (will annotate actions).

Sam Ortiz: Will post "Sam taking primary" at 02:00 PST and include the canary results. If anything unexpected during 02:00–03:30 I'll escalate to Kai and Marta.

Priya Nair: Thank you, everyone. Really appreciate the split cover. I’ll still be reachable by DM until 01:30 in case you need any context while I wait at the gate. :airplane:

Jordan Lee: :thumbsup: See you in thread for the handoff updates.

Marta Reyes: LGTM. Closing the loop — rotation updated and calendar confirmed. If any of you need to change coverage please post here so ops knows.

Jordan Lee: (reaction) :eyes:
